Class NkStyleText

java.lang.Object
org.lwjgl.system.Pointer.Default
org.lwjgl.system.Struct<NkStyleText>
org.lwjgl.nuklear.NkStyleText
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, NativeResource, Pointer
@NativeType("struct nk_style_text") public class NkStyleText extends Struct<NkStyleText> implements NativeResource
struct nk_style_text {
    struct nk_color color;
    struct nk_vec2 padding;
    float color_factor;
    float disabled_factor;
}

  • Constructor Details

    • NkStyleText

      public NkStyleText(ByteBuffer container)
      Creates a NkStyleText instance at the current position of the specified ByteBuffer container. Changes to the buffer's content will be visible to the struct instance and vice versa.

      The created instance holds a strong reference to the container object.
